# VidyBack

> VidyBack is a social media content tool for small online stores. It connects to your store, pulls in your products and branding, and turns them into short videos, images, Reels, Stories and posts using ready-made templates, with AI-written captions. You review the content and schedule it, or let VidyBack auto-post it, to Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and Pinterest.

## How it works

1. Connect a Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Etsy, Ecwid or Jumpseller store (or enter its URL). VidyBack picks up your products, logo and brand colors.
2. Choose templates. VidyBack fills them with your product photos, names and prices to make on-brand videos and images in each platform's format.
3. Captions and hashtags are written with AI, and you can edit them.
4. Schedule posts across the week, or post right away, to your connected Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and Pinterest accounts.
5. Optional: New Product Auto Post checks your store twice a day for newly added products, makes a short video for each and schedules it (up to 10 posts a day).

VidyBack is template-based with AI assistance. You stay in control of what gets posted: preview, edit, skip or reschedule any post.

## Integrations

- Store platforms: Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Etsy, Ecwid, Jumpseller
- Social channels: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube (including Shorts), Pinterest
- VidyBack is available on the [Shopify App Store](https://apps.shopify.com/vidyback) and as a [Jumpseller app](https://jumpseller.in/support/vidyback/).

## Pricing

- Free plan: 3 products, free templates, 480p video, no auto-posting.
- Pro plan: $14.99/month. 5 products, Pro templates, up to 1080p, unlimited downloads, auto-posting and scheduling, bulk video ads, Brand Kit, custom music, priority support.
- 7-day free trial.

## Who it's for

Small ecommerce and DTC store owners, mostly in the US, UK and Canada, who need regular social content but don't have a designer, video editor or social media manager.
